notes:
v4.6.48 — Bots work on BOTH brokers + a universal minimum-confidence gate

✨ MAKE BOT — choose compatible brokers (tick boxes)
• New bots are now generated BROKER-AGNOSTIC: they use the APEX framework, never a broker SDK directly, so the SAME bot runs on Alpaca AND IBKR (and on the cloud).
• MAKE BOT now has 'Compatible brokers' checkboxes (Alpaca / IBKR) — both ticked by default, so every new bot works on both. The choice is stamped in the bot's META (brokers:).
• (Previously bots were generated for one broker only via a radio button and locked to that broker's SDK.)

✨ Minimum-confidence now works for ANY bot
• A bot can return a 'confidence' (0–1) with its trade. The framework SKIPS the trade when it's below your 'Minimum confidence to trade' slider — on local AND cloud (the slider value is synced to the server).
• Your CRYPTO bot now reports a confidence (the R² / 'cleanliness' of its trend fit), so the slider finally gates it: raise it to trade only on strong, clean trends; lower it to trade more often.

Note (IBKR + crypto): IBKR lists only major coins (BTC/ETH/LTC/BCH); APEX auto-skips coins it can't trade, so for IBKR keep crypto universes to majors.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
